Commentary.Commentary: Right then, this is it from this series as this tour draws to a close. The Sri Lankan team gathers behind the 'Champions' board for photographs after clinching the T20I series against Afghanistan with a 2-1 victory. Sri Lanka won the One-Off Test, and followed up by clean sweeping the ODI series before this. Sri Lanka will now travel to Bangladesh for a three-match T20I series and a two-match Test series. Whereas, Afghanistan will fly to the UAE for their all-format series including a One-Off Test against Ireland. Thank you for tuning with us, but the other cricketing action continues and you can surely join us with all the action. Till then, take care, cheers!

The skipper of Sri Lanka and also the Player of the Series, Wanindu Hasaranga says that his team played really well in the first two games. He credits the bowlers for the way they bowled. States that they wanted to test the bench strength and therefore, they made 4 changes in this game. Adds that Chameera will be returning from injury which is a good sign. Ends by thanking the crowd for their support throughout the series.

The skipper of Afghanistan Ibrahim Zadran says that it was a close game but he is happy that they won the game. Adds that tough for them to lose the series but says that they showed a good fight throughout the tour. He says it was tactical to make changes as they wanted to test the bench strength as well for the upcoming T20 World Cup. Says they played well in the first match but lost by a close margin. Adds that they struggled to chase in this series and didn't repeat the mistakes in this game and managed to win. Ends up by saying that he is hopeful for a good series against Ireland.

Rahmanullah Gurbaz is the Player of the Match for his blistering 70 off 43. He says that he is pleased with his knock. Mentions that he was going through a hard time with the bat but was able to bat freely in this game. Shares that the coach gave him the confidence. Further adds that he does mind batting first or chasing. Ends by saying that he is happy that he and his team learned from their mistakes and did not commit the same mistakes in this game.
The Presentation ceremony...

Earlier in the game, Afghanistan started off to a flier with Hazratullah Zazai and Gurbaz wreaking the attack right on and did not give any chance for the bowlers to settle in. Gurbaz, despite pulling his hamstring, fought like a wounded lion and scored a blistering 70 and helped Afghanistan to mount a steep total of 209 on the board with some crucial contributions from Azmatullah Omarzai and Mohammad Nabi in the backend. And coming to defend, it was an uphill task for Sri Lanka to chase it down, Pathum Nissanka notched up a valiant 60 off 30 and got retired hurt. But it all took the last ball of the innings to decide the victor. Afghanistan won the game by just 3 runs, and finally tasted a solitary success in this tour.

Afghanistan, despite putting a mammoth total on the board, began ordinarily with the ball as they conceded too many boundaries first up and allowed the opposition batters to construct a strong opening stand. Fareed Ahmed, though he went for plenty in his second over, saw the back of Kusal Mendis courtesy of a sensational breathtaking catch from Sharafuddin. Noor Ahmed was introduced into the attack, and right away he got rid of Kusal Perera off a peach of a delivery on his very second ball and exerted pressure on the hosts after an ordinary Powerplay. Noor Ahmed and Mohammad Nabi continued to bowl in tandem and bowled some decent overs without conceding too many which bore fruit for Noor Ahmed as he managed to dismiss Kusal Perera, and Mohammad Nabi too joined the party as he got rid of the dangerous Wanindu Hasaranga and finished off his spell with a 2-wicket haul. Qais Ahmed, who was brought in as a concussion sub, picked a very crucial scalp of Sadeera and exerted more pressure on the opposition. The spin trio of Nabi, Noor, and Qais managed to contain the Lankan batters and in the end, Karim Janat and Wafadar Momand somehow cleaned up successfully in the end and helped Afghanistan to register the first win of this tour to Sri Lanka across the formats.

416 runs struck in this last T20 International and it couldn't have been a more thrilling end to this tour. After a few hiccups in the end, Afghanistan narrowly win this third T20I by 3 runs. But Sri Lanka take the series by 2-1. Sri Lanka started off on a decent note as Pathum Nissanka and Kusal Mendis negotiated the Powerplay pretty well. Nissanka was the aggressor as he struck some seriously glorious boundaries employing the square cut shots and helped the partnership to flourish. He rocketed to his fifty inside the Powerplay and provided a blistering start for the hosts. Kusal Mendis played a crucial anchor role as he rotated the strike but perished on an awkward shot right before the end of the Powerplay. Kusal Perera, who had a successful outing in the recently concluded ILT20, stayed only for a couple of deliveries and departed on a silver duck. Suddenly, Sri Lanka found themselves in a bit of trouble. Sadeera Samarawickrama was in for Pathum Nissanka, who made a valiant quickfire 60 off just 30 balls, but he walked back to the pavilion getting retired hurt, pulling his hamstring. Sadeera, along with Kamindu, tried to steady the ship and the former notched up a quick 23 off just 12 balls before departing. But Kamindu Mendis continued to strike boundaries after being dropped and notched up a brilliant half-century. The required run rate was creeping up as Angelo Mathews couldn't hold onto it and got dismissed. Dasun Shanaka showed the intent but fell prey to a mix up between the wickets. Sri Lanka, in the end, lost by 3 runs.

Commentary.Commentary: Ouch! Pathum Nissanka is looking in some discomfort and is unable to continue. Pathum Nissanka is retired hurt and he is walking back to the dressing room. He would be so disappointed with this as he was up and running with a blistering 60 off just 30 rocks.
Sadeera Samarawickrama is the next batter in.

SIX! BANG! Afghanistan having flashbacks of Maxwell from the World Cup here. This is flighted, full and around middle, Pathum Nissanka goes down and smokes it over the deep mid-wicket fence for a biggie. However, he falls down on the ground right after hitting it and it does not look good for him.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 8.3: Noor Ahmad to Pathum Nissanka, Six!

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up, full and on off, Wanindu Hasaranga taps it wide of short covers for a single, the fielder misses his shy at the bowler's end but misses. However, the batters cannot run the overthrow as Nissanka is not able to move at all.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 8.2: Noor Ahmad to Wanindu Hasaranga, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Just short! This is short again and around off, Wanindu Hasaranga tries to cut but gets an outside edge, the ball drops just in front of short third man.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 8.1: Noor Ahmad to Wanindu Hasaranga, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter, short and outside off, way outside off, Wanindu Hasaranga fails to reach it. Wided.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 8.1: Noor Ahmad to Wanindu Hasaranga, Wide!

Commentary.Commentary: Goes a bit short and on middle, Wanindu Hasaranga moves back and flicks it through square leg for one.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 7.6: Mohammad Nabi to Wanindu Hasaranga, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up, full and on leg, Wanindu Hasaranga goes down to slog-sweep it but fails to connect.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 7.5: Mohammad Nabi to Wanindu Hasaranga, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Arm-ball now, on middle, angling away, Wanindu Hasaranga stays back and blocks it out.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 7.4: Mohammad Nabi to Wanindu Hasaranga, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter, full and on middle, Pathum Nissanka flicks it towards deep square leh and hobbles across for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 7.3: Mohammad Nabi to Pathum Nissanka, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Pathum Nissanka has just completed his Fifty but now he has pulled his hamstring and looks in some discomfort. The physio runs to the middle and checks him up. Nissanka is on the ground as he is being treated. He was seen limping while completing the second run and looked immobile. The two Umpires also stand near him while he is being strapped up. He looks fine to continue now. Also, an update on Sharafuddin Ashraf as he has been subbed out due to the concussion rule and Qais Ahmad comes in for him as the concussion substitute. A like-for-like replacement. A spinner comes in for a spinner.

Short again and on middle, Pathum Nissanka moves back and heaves it towards deep mid-wicket and turns around for the second run. Oh..no! This is not looking good for Sri Lanka as he limps back to complete the second run and looks in some discomfort here.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 7.2: Mohammad Nabi to Pathum Nissanka, 2 runs.

Commentary.Commentary: FIFTY FOR NISSANKA! A fine knock from him and this is his first one at home, but he knows that the job is not done here. Mohammad Nabi begins with a short delivery, on middle, Pathum Nissanka pulls it wide of deep mid-wicket where the fielder dives to his left to stop it well. Two runs taken.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 7.1: Mohammad Nabi to Pathum Nissanka, 2 runs.

Commentary.Commentary: Mohammad Nabi replaces Fareed Ahmad.
Tossed up, full and on off, Pathum Nissanka eases it towards long off for one more. Just 5 runs and a wicket from the over!
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 6.6: Noor Ahmad to Pathum Nissanka, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: In the air...safe! Noor Ahmad slows it up this time, full and on off, Wanindu Hasaranga goes down to sweep but gets a top edge, the ball flies in the air but lands well in front of the incoming long on fielder. They cross.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 6.5: Noor Ahmad to Wanindu Hasaranga, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Looped up, full and on leg, Pathum Nissanka tucks it through mid-wicket for one.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 6.4: Noor Ahmad to Pathum Nissanka, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Flighted, full and on middle, Wanindu Hasaranga drills it towards long on for a run.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 6.3: Noor Ahmad to Wanindu Hasaranga, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Wanindu Hasaranga, the Sri Lankan skipper and the man in-form promotes himself to number 4.

OUT! LBW! Noor Ahmad strikes straightaway! Kusal Perera after scoring over 300 runs in the recently concluded ILT20 has to walk back for a duck here. This is the googly, full and on middle, turns in a bit, Kusal Perera goes down to sweep it away but misses it completely and gets hit on the pads right in front of the stumps. A huge shout for LBW, and up goes the finger. Perera takes the review after consulting with his partner. UltraEdge confirms no bat involved and Ball Tracking shows three reds. Sri Lanka lose their second and a review as well!
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 6.2: Noor Ahmad to Kusal Perera, OUT! lbw b Noor Ahmad.

Commentary.Commentary: Noor Ahmad starts with a floated delivery, short and on middle, Pathum Nissanka stays back and nudges it through mid-wicket for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 6.1: Noor Ahmad to Pathum Nissanka, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Time for spin now as Noor Ahmad is into the attack. He replaces Azmatullah Omarzai.
On a length and around off, Kusal Perera pushes it towards short covers. Sri Lanka are 64/1 at the end of the Powerplay. Not much difference as Afghanistan were 72 for no loss at the same point.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.6: Fareed Ahmad to Kusal Perera, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Halt! Sharafuddin Ashraf looks in pain as he hits his head on the ground while completing his catch while backpaddling. He is in tremendous pain and is on the ground. All the Afghan players stand surrounding him. The stretcher is out but good signs as he is on his feet and walks out of the field as two Afghan subs help him. Also, Kusal Perera is in at number 3 for Sri Lanka.

OUT! IN THE AIR AND GONE! Fareed Ahmad after all that pelting, gets a wicket now! He continues with his fuller length, keeps it away form the batter outside off, Kusal Mendis throws his hands at it but only manages to slice it up in the air, Sharafuddin Ashraf at cover-point back peddles, keeps his eyes firmly on the ball, and pouches it on the reverse-cup diving backward. However, he hits the back of the head hard on the ground, stays down and looks in a lot of pain, but keeps hold of the ball. Sri Lanka lose their first wicket!
Commentary.Howout: c Sharafuddin Ashraf b Fareed Ahmad
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.5: Fareed Ahmad to Kusal Mendis, OUT! c Sharafuddin Ashraf b Fareed Ahmad.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Kusal Mendis makes full use of the Free Hit! Fareed Ahmad misses his length and bowls a juicy full toss around off, Kusal Mendis reaches out for it and smacks it over extra covers for four more runs. 20 runs off the over and still 2 more balls to go.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.4: Fareed Ahmad to Kusal Mendis, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Oh...no! Fareed Ahmad has overstepped here and it is going from bad to worse for him. He serves this full again and on off, Pathum Nissanka drills it wide of mid off where the fielder dives to his right to make a fine stop. Only a single taken. Free Hit coming up...
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.4: Fareed Ahmad to Pathum Nissanka, No ball!

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! TWO IN TWO! Fareed Ahmad comes over the wicket, lands this back of a length and around off, Pathum Nissanka makes room to free his arms and crunches it over point for another boundary.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.3: Fareed Ahmad to Pathum Nissanka, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! 10 runs off the first 2 balls already! Fareed Ahmad pitches it up around middle this time, Pathum Nissanka stays put in his crease and lofts it through the line and over the bowler's head for a one-bounce four.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.2: Fareed Ahmad to Pathum Nissanka, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! Wow...what a shot! Fareed Ahmad serves this full and on off, angling in, Pathum Nissanka shuffles across, uses the pace of the ball and wristily whips it over the deep backward square leg fence for a biggie. Also, the 50-run partnership comes up between the two openers.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.1: Fareed Ahmad to Pathum Nissanka, Six!

Commentary.Commentary: Bowls it outside off on a fuller length, Kusal Mendis looks to clear the in-field over covers but misses to connect and the ball carries to the keeper. A tentative appeal in the field for caught behind. Ibrahim Zadran has a brief chat with the keeper and aborts to take the review.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.6: Azmatullah Omarzai to Kusal Mendis, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: WIDE! Will have to reload that one. Angles down leg on a length, Kusal Mendis misses out on his flick and the keeper just gets the glove diving to his right. Wide given.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.6: Azmatullah Omarzai to Kusal Mendis, Wide!

Commentary.Commentary: Angling on the pads on a fuller length, Pathum Nissanka flicks it a bit uppishly towards deep backward square leg for one.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.5: Azmatullah Omarzai to Pathum Nissanka, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: On the back of a length around off, Pathum Nissanka cuts it straight off the back foot to point.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.4: Azmatullah Omarzai to Pathum Nissanka, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Shot! On a fuller length angling down leg, Pathum Nissanka shuffles a bit across the leg stump and lofts it over the bowler's head for a boundary to the right of long off.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.3: Azmatullah Omarzai to Pathum Nissanka, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Short and around off at 139 clicks, Pathum Nissanka hits it to mid off.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.2: Azmatullah Omarzai to Pathum Nissanka, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: On top of off on a length, Pathum Nissanka swivels and pull towards deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.1: Azmatullah Omarzai to Pathum Nissanka, 2 runs.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! A sting won't bother him! Slants it across off on a fuller length, Kusal Mendis clears his front foot and drives it aerially over the covers for a boundary to end the over. 10 runs from the over.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.6: Fareed Ahmad to Kusal Mendis, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Halt! Kusal Mendis looks in a bit of pain here after getting hit just above his right elbow. The physio is in to check on him and apply some magic spray on the affected area. We are good to go...

On the back of a length and quicker at 136 clicks on the top of middle, Kusal Mendis misses to pull and it thuds his right bicep. He is grimacing in pain as it stings him hard. And the physio is out to treat him.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.5: Fareed Ahmad to Kusal Mendis, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Fareed pitches it on a fuller length angling across off, Kusal Mendis slaps the drive towards point where Nabi stops it bending low in time.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.4: Fareed Ahmad to Kusal Mendis, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Full and on the middle and off corridor, Pathum Nissanka hits it with the inside half of the blade to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.3: Fareed Ahmad to Pathum Nissanka, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Misfield! On the back of a length slanting across off, Kusal Mendis cuts it straight to point where the fielder fumbles to collect and allows the batters to cross for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.2: Fareed Ahmad to Kusal Mendis, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! In the gap! Short and on the middle from over the wicket from Fareed, Kusal Mendis short-arm jabs at it towards deep square leg for a boundary. Noor Ahmed fails to pull it back before the fence in the deep.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.1: Fareed Ahmad to Kusal Mendis, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Handsomely driven away! Slightly more width on a hard length from Wafadar, Pathum Nissanka cuts it on the up in front of the square towards deep extra cover for a boundary. This is an ordinary bowling. 11 runs from it. Sri Lanka are up and running now.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.6: Wafadar Momand to Pathum Nissanka, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: On the stumps and on a length, Kusal Mendis waits for this pace off delivery and tucks it with soft hands towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.5: Wafadar Momand to Kusal Mendis, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: A deceiving slower one on a fuller length around off, Pathum Nissanka gets the leading edge on the flick and eludes the bowler towards mid on for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.4: Wafadar Momand to Pathum Nissanka, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Nissanka looks unstoppable! Classy! Just a bit of width on offer on a length, Pathum Nissanka stays put and cuts it square through the cover-point for a boundary. Sweet timing on that one and the ball races away to the fence.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.3: Wafadar Momand to Pathum Nissanka, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Angles it into the batter from the off stump on a hard length, Kusal Mendis flicks it across towards long on for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.2: Wafadar Momand to Kusal Mendis, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Pace off and outside off on a length, Kusal Mendis cuts it straight towards point off the back foot.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.1: Wafadar Momand to Kusal Mendis, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Short and angles into the off stump, Kusal Mendis pulls it on the bounce towards widish long on for a single to end the over.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.6: Azmatullah Omarzai to Kusal Mendis, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: On the back of a length on the top of off, Pathum Nissanka mistimes the heave straight to mid on and runs a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.5: Azmatullah Omarzai to Pathum Nissanka, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Punished with grace! Azmat bowls it down leg on a fuller length, Pathum Nissanka flicks it nicely with the pace through fine leg for a boundary. He looks in a good nick right on.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.4: Azmatullah Omarzai to Pathum Nissanka, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Absolute beauty! A slower one just outside off, Pathum Nissanka gets beaten on his defence as he plays inside the line of the ball. The ball carries to the keeper on a couple of bounces.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.3: Azmatullah Omarzai to Pathum Nissanka, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: On the back of a length outside off, Pathum Nissanka rides on the bounce and cuts it square but finds the cover fielder.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.2: Azmatullah Omarzai to Pathum Nissanka, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Straight and full on off, Pathum Nissanka defends it to covers on his front foot.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.1: Azmatullah Omarzai to Pathum Nissanka, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Who will bowl from the other end? It will be Azmatullah Omarzai.
Sneaks back in from the off stump line on a fuller length, Kusal Mendis flicks it straight to mid on. End of the first over. Sri Lanka fetch 9 from it.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.6: Wafadar Momand to Kusal Mendis, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: A pace-off delivery outside off on a fuller length, Pathum Nissanka cuts it square of the wicket and looks to clear the point fielder but he does well to restrict it to just a single with his timely dive to his left.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.5: Wafadar Momand to Pathum Nissanka, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Pulled away nicely! On a shortish length outside off, Pathum Nissanka drags his pull shot on the up and clears the mid on fielder for a boundary toward long on. Not an ideal start from Wafadar Momand.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.4: Wafadar Momand to Pathum Nissanka, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Goes wider of the crease and offers a bit of width on a length, Pathum Nissanka cuts it on the bounce to cover.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.3: Wafadar Momand to Pathum Nissanka, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Gets his length correct this time. A considerable inward movement from outside off, Pathum Nissanka drives it straight to mid on off the front foot.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.2: Wafadar Momand to Pathum Nissanka, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! A fabulous start for the hosts! Off the mark in style! Swings it into the batter from off on a fuller length, Pathum Nissanka whips across the angle and guides the ball towards deep fine leg for a boundary.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.1: Wafadar Momand to Pathum Nissanka, Four!
